description: Golden vectors for the app parameter of the open_app action: which values name an application, and how macOS turns one into the arguments of /usr/bin/open. Replayed by the macOS, Linux and Windows suites.
rule: The value names the application the way the OS launches one: an application name, a path, a macOS bundle identifier, a Linux desktop-file id, or anything the Windows shell runs. It is valid when it is not empty, has no leading or trailing whitespace and holds no control character (U+0000 to U+001F, U+007F). Whether it names an installed application is checked when the action runs. macOS opens a value made of three or more dot-separated letters, digits and hyphens, not ending in .app, by bundle identifier (open -b), and every other value by name or path (open -a). Linux runs gtk-launch with the value; Windows runs the value.
